caption: The drawing features a two-story building colored in light pink with yellow-brown accents around the windows and a gray-colored roof. The building has a rectangular shape with a section that protrudes slightly outward in the center, which includes an arched doorway. Multiple tall, narrow windows with light gray glass are visible on both floors, with the upper windows aligned directly above the lower windows. A flagpole is mounted on the roof at the left side of the building, flying a red flag with a white symbol. A white fence with vertical posts and round finials encloses a portion of the front yard, where there is also visible green grass. A tree with a brown trunk and green foliage stands in the foreground to the right, leaning slightly to the right, and there are additional indistinct green shapes behind the building, suggesting more vegetation. The entire composition is drawn with pencil or ink outlines and filled in with watercolor, and the background is left mostly blank with a light tan wash.
title: House with Flag
